what_this_is: Founder-approved, record-level corrections applied to the frozen research snapshot behind atlas-tools/cluster1-cost-evidence.json (and so behind garden-room-prices-ireland.html and the price section of Living in the Garden). Read by atlas-tools/build-cluster1-cost-evidence.py and by the --freeze step of atlas-tools/build-garden-room-prices.py. A correction never types a figure: each listed product takes its record from the universe at a deployed commit, or leaves the snapshot when that universe no longer carries it. Every figure is then recomputed by the same functions that built the original evidence.
what_this_is_not: Not a refresh, and not a way to change any product the founder has not approved. A full evidence refresh replaces the snapshot and empties this register.

baseEvidence.note: The evidence as first committed (11 Oct 2026). The generator must reproduce it byte for byte from the base snapshot, with no correction applied, before it may apply any correction.
